name: dragonmaster_outcast_your_upkeep_makes_it
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control six or more lands, create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.' Seat 0 controls Dragonmaster Outcast and six Mountains: the Dragon comes in seat 0's own upkeep of the opening turn, before any opponent's upkeep (the pack stops in turn 1).
